title: Fletcher Henderson album from John Hammond
summary: He cannot say when he joined Henderson but has the unplayed album John Hammond gave him.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: When did you join Fletcher Henderson's band?
I don't know. Switched around so many times. I have those records back there, too. In fact, I have the whole album and I haven't played one of the records out yet. I went down to John Hammond's ...
What album is that? Fletcher Henderson album,
... do you want to see it?

I don't know. At one time he called me up and said he wanted to see me so while I was down there he gave me this album, a Fletcher Henderson album and they all are in only one piece in the box. I don't play them.
